item.text:
Continued. I generalized F1 with a parameterized recovery matrix covering local recovery state and remote reply status.

`TestAuditRecoveryMatrix` tests:

- Local state: `NONE` vs local `PREACCEPTED`.
- Remote status: `PREACCEPTED_EQ`, `ACCEPTED`, or `COMMITTED` at `VBallot=5`.

All six combinations fail:

```
localNone/remotePreacceptedEQ   selected key=0  // NOOP
localNone/remoteAccepted        selected key=0  // NOOP
localNone/remoteCommitted       selected key=0  // NOOP
localPreaccepted/...            selected key=1  // local stale value
```

The remote value at the higher value ballot is never selected. This confirms the F1 masking behavior is systematic, not specific to one status combination.

The strongest end-to-end result remains the all-alive state-machine divergence: after a partitioned leader heals, replica 0 has the chosen PUT and replicas 1-4 have `COMMITTED` NOOP; execution leaves key 7 present only on replica 0.

Current status: four cluster controls pass; 31 epaxos finding tests fail as intended; both client failover tests fail; `go build ./...` passes; implementation files remain byte-identical to `../source`.
